title: Best Iphone Duo (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were based on products mentioned in PCMag (source 1), PCMag personal site (source 5) and a personal blog (source 6).
assumptions: No price comparisons were made because only the iPhone Duo price appears in the sources.

verdict.line: Picture a tech‑savvy user who wants Apple’s ecosystem in a foldable form. The Duo offers high‑quality durable hardware, anti‑reflective display and class‑leading battery life, making it the top choice for most buyers. The catch: its button placement feels awkward and Touch ID is a step back.
